meta.title: Project AEGIS-PHARMA — System Architecture Map
meta.scope: Challenge package + planned submission architecture (Track A/B)
meta.safety: Synthetic training only. No real GxP, clinical, PV, supply, or recall decisions.
meta.description_for_agents: Use this graph to reason about components, trust boundaries, mandatory workflows, evaluation, and fail-closed gates. Prefer offline deterministic paths. Never propose autonomous disposition, final PV conclusions, stock allocation/shipment, quality-status change, or recall initiation.

nodes.label: Human Reviewers / QP / PV / Supply
nodes.tooltip: Accountable humans for batch readiness, PV reviews, supply approvals. AI authority is none or draft-only. Author ≠ sole approver.

nodes.label: FDE Team (P1–P5)
nodes.tooltip: Five seats: Product, Domain, Build, GxP/ISO, Sec/Eval. Work only under submission/. Dual-track Track A (G1–G8) and Track B (G9).

nodes.label: Cursor Rules / Agents / Skills
nodes.tooltip: Always-on pharma-fde rules; security/test/evidence reviewer agents; GxP/PV/supply skills. Agents OFF until G4 PASS in the project plan.

nodes.label: Integrated Case
nodes.tooltip: Fictional enterprise narrative and problem framing. Immutable challenge input.

nodes.label: 84 Injects (13 dimensions)
nodes.tooltip: Disclosed cross-linked injects. Mirror under submission/evaluation/; never silently resolve deliberate conflicts.

nodes.label: Operational Datasets (~139)
nodes.tooltip: Synthetic LIMS/MES/PV/supply/privacy datasets plus RELATIONSHIP_MODEL.csv. Preserve units, times, verbatim values, uncertainty.

nodes.label: Knowledge Docs (32) + Catalog
nodes.tooltip: Mixed-authority policies including superseded/poisoned docs. Require status, authority, signature/hash, applicability checks.

nodes.label: Source Documents
nodes.tooltip: Protocols, CCDS, EMA letter, LIMS contracts, cold-chain associations. Cite with provenance; do not normalize away conflicts.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Contracts
nodes.tooltip: batch_response, pv_response, supply_response, evidence_item schemas. additionalProperties=false. Prohibited fields rejected.

nodes.label: Public Fixtures PUB-01…15
nodes.tooltip: Reproducible input bundles, not answer keys (expected_answer_included=no).

nodes.label: Rubric / Scoring / DoD
nodes.tooltip: 180-point model, hard gates (GxP/safety/security), DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md, SUBMISSION_EVIDENCE_STANDARD.

nodes.label: Artefact Templates 01–30
nodes.tooltip: Structured participant artefact shells. Completed copies live under submission/artefacts/.

nodes.label: Offline Inject Explorer
nodes.tooltip: Static HTML/JS explorer for disclosed injects. XSS lesson: prefer textContent, never innerHTML for untrusted data.

nodes.label: FILE_HASHES / MANIFEST
nodes.tooltip: Integrity baseline for non-submission trees. Do not edit to force green verifier after submission work exists.

nodes.label: run_capstone.py Preflight
nodes.tooltip: Hour-0 orchestrator: verify_package → baseline_diagnostics → check_submission_structure --scaffold. Optional --serve for app.

nodes.label: verify_package.py
nodes.tooltip: Challenge-tree integrity checks. Authoritative at Hour-0 only for whole-package PASS claim.

nodes.label: test_contracts.py
nodes.tooltip: Runs positive/negative contract samples. Must stay green from architecture onward (3+/3−).

nodes.label: check_submission_structure.py
nodes.tooltip: --scaffold and --final structural gates for submission/ minima (artefacts, src, tests, evaluation, evidence, runbooks, scripts, app).

nodes.label: hash_submission.py
nodes.tooltip: Freeze and --check submission hashes for clean-room and G7/G9.

nodes.label: rebuild_explorer_data.py
nodes.tooltip: Rebuild/check explorer data.js from inject sources when regenerating package views.

nodes.label: Brownfield Starter (unsafe)
nodes.tooltip: Intentionally defective Python/JS legacy portal. System-under-test for baseline eval; not a solution.

nodes.label: baseline_diagnostics.py
nodes.tooltip: Partial defect clue only. Incomplete by design—do not treat as full assessment.

nodes.label: Tool Manifests (approved/poisoned)
nodes.tooltip: Signed allowlist vs poisoned/unsigned tool manifests (INJ-065/066). Deny by default at execution.

nodes.label: submission/ (writable)
nodes.tooltip: Only writable solution boundary. All participant code, artefacts, evidence, evaluation framework, runbooks.

nodes.label: Shared Evidence Resolver
nodes.tooltip: Emits evidence_item with real SHA-256, source_preserved=true, authority/as-of/uncertainty. Shared by WF A/B/C.

nodes.label: AuthZ @ Execution
nodes.tooltip: Checks current user, purpose, object, role, tool authorization at execution time. Deny stale/revoked cache (INJ-067).

nodes.label: Knowledge Catalog Gate
nodes.tooltip: Rejects superseded/untrusted knowledge when status/hash/authority fail. Treat retrieved docs as untrusted until verified.

nodes.label: RELATIONSHIP_MODEL Checker
nodes.tooltip: Identity/link resolution against RELATIONSHIP_MODEL. Abstain on ambiguous entity links; never invent joins.

nodes.label: Offline / Deterministic Mode
nodes.tooltip: Must-run path without model inference. AI-disabled continuity for ≥14 days with runbooks.

nodes.label: Workflow A — Batch Evidence
nodes.tooltip: GxP batch-review evidence reconciliation. readiness_state only. FORBIDDEN: disposition, release, reject, reprocess, relabel, recall.

nodes.label: Workflow B — PV Intake
nodes.tooltip: PV intake/signal support. Preserve source_facts, clocks, listedness, duplicates. FORBIDDEN: final seriousness/causality/expectedness/reportability/signal decisions.

nodes.label: Workflow C — Supply Options
nodes.tooltip: Shortage/cold-chain draft options. no_side_effects=true. FORBIDDEN: reserve, allocate, ship, quality-status change, recall initiation.

nodes.label: submission/app Demonstrator
nodes.tooltip: Safe demonstrator UI for happy/abstain paths. Use text nodes; no innerHTML with untrusted content.

nodes.label: Eval Datasets
nodes.tooltip: Normal/edge/adversarial/metamorphic/outage cases. Required & prohibited behaviours; hard-gate flags. No answer keys.

nodes.label: Eval Adapter
nodes.tooltip: Connector capturing input, output, evidence, tools, retries, errors, approvals, side effects, latency.

nodes.label: Eval Runner
nodes.tooltip: Executes suites; records scenario ID, hashes, versions, result, evidence path, reviewer, gate outcome.

nodes.label: Deterministic Graders
nodes.tooltip: Schema, facts, evidence, prohibited actions, authority, security, temporal/unit, trajectory, latency. ± unit tests each.

nodes.label: Release Policies / Hard Gates
nodes.tooltip: Automatic failure rules: schema fail, fabricated facts, silent conflict resolution, stale auth, untrusted tools, prohibited side effects, missing manual mode, etc.

nodes.label: Eval Reports
nodes.tooltip: summary.json, detailed_results.jsonl, scorecard.csv, failed_cases.json, final_evaluation_report.md + package JSON results.

nodes.label: Deterministic Tests
nodes.tooltip: Golden/edge/adversarial/subgroup/outage/prohibited tests. Tests-before-inference for hard gates.

nodes.label: Scripts setup/run/test/evaluate/reset
nodes.tooltip: Reproducible operator commands for clean-room installability.

nodes.label: Runbooks (Ops / Incident / AI-off)
nodes.tooltip: SETUP, OPERATIONS, INCIDENT, AI_DISABLED with kill switch, rollback, prerequisites.

nodes.label: Submission Evidence Pack
nodes.tooltip: submission_manifest.csv, file_hashes.csv, test_results.json, evaluation_results.json, FinOps delivery log, decision/RAID logs.

nodes.label: Artefacts 01–30 + Plan
nodes.tooltip: Business, domain, architecture, GxP, threat, TEVV, FinOps, TOM, readiness, pitch. Includes ProjectPlan FINAL.

nodes.label: Final Defence / Readiness Board
nodes.tooltip: 13 defence elements; go/conditional/pivot/pause/stop. G9 Production Readiness Board for prod-ready claim only.

flows.name: Hour-0 Preflight
flows.description: Establish package integrity baseline and scaffold before writing solution code.

flows.name: Workflow A — Batch Evidence Reconciliation
flows.description: Advisory batch evidence path with fail-closed disposition boundary.

flows.name: Workflow B — PV Intake Support
flows.description: Preserve source facts/clocks/listedness; escalate humans; never emit final safety conclusions.

flows.name: Workflow C — Supply / Cold-Chain Options
flows.description: Draft ranked options with no_side_effects; no reserve/allocate/ship/recall.

flows.name: Shared Evidence Resolution
flows.description: Authority-checked retrieval and hashed evidence_item emission for all workflows.

flows.name: Evaluation Stack (Cursor Eval Architecture)
flows.description: Datasets → adapter → runner → graders → policies → reports against SUT.

flows.name: Brownfield Baseline Eval
flows.description: Measure unmodified starter/ before improved submission/src; capture gaps.

flows.name: Contract Fail-Closed Validation
flows.description: Positive samples pass; prohibited disposition/reportability/side-effect samples fail.

flows.name: Tool / Agent Authorization Deny Path
flows.description: Unsigned or poisoned tool manifests and stale auth denied at execution (INJ-065/066/067).

flows.name: AI-Disabled Continuity
flows.description: Deterministic offline path with runbooks when models/tools unavailable.

flows.name: Defence & Inspection Evidence Path
flows.description: Trace artefacts and machine evidence to go/conditional/pivot/pause/stop recommendation.

flows.name: Inject Discovery (Explorer)
flows.description: Browse disclosed injects offline to plan coverage without editing challenge trees.
